'''Ulrike M. Sattler''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|MAE}} is a [[professor]] of [[computer science]] in the [[information management]] group of the [[Department of Computer Science, University of Manchester|Department of Computer Science]] at the [[University of Manchester]]<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.manchester.ac.uk/research/Ulrike.sattler/ |title=Prof Ulrike Sattler, research profile|publisher=University of Manchester |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140416181432/http://www.manchester.ac.uk/research/Ulrike.sattler/|archive-date=2014-04-16}}</ref><ref name=sattleru>{{cite web|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141214130922/http://www.cs.man.ac.uk/~sattler/|archive-date=2014-12-14|title=Uli Sattler homepage|publisher=University of Manchester|url=http://www.cs.man.ac.uk/~sattler}}</ref> and a visiting professor at the [[University of Oslo]].<ref name=dlbook/>

== Education ==
Sattler completed her [[PhD]] in 1998 under the supervision of [[Franz Baader]]<ref name="mathgene">{{MathGenealogy}}</ref> at [[RWTH Aachen University]] in Germany.

==Career and research==
Sattler moved to the University of Manchester as [[senior lecturer]] in 2003, was promoted to [[Reader (academic rank)|reader]] in 2006 and then to professor in 2007.<ref name=mae /> Sattler's research<ref name="googlescholar">{{Google scholar id}}</ref><ref name="dblp">{{DBLP}}</ref><ref name="scopus">{{Scopus id}}</ref> focuses on logic to support [[knowledge representation]] including [[description logic]],<ref>{{Cite book | last1 = Horrocks | first1 = I. | author-link1 = Ian Horrocks| last2 = Sattler | first2 = U. | author-link2 = Ulrike Sattler| last3 = Tobies | first3 = S. | doi = 10.1007/3-540-48242-3_11 | chapter = Practical Reasoning for Expressive Description Logics | title = Logic for Programming and Automated Reasoning | series = Lecture Notes in Computer Science | volume = 1705 | pages = 161 | year = 1999 | isbn = 978-3-540-66492-5 | arxiv = cs/0005014 | s2cid = 1599841 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Baader | first1 = F. | author-link1 = Franz Baader| last2 = Sattler | first2 = U. |title=An Overview of Tableau Algorithms for Description Logics| author-link2 = Ulrike Sattler| journal = Studia Logica | volume = 69 | pages = 5–40 | year = 2001 | doi = 10.1023/A:1013882326814 | s2cid = 2707416 }}</ref> [[Dynamic logic (modal logic)|Dynamic logic]] and [[Modal logic]]. She is also investigating the [[inference]] problems, [[Computational complexity theory|complexity theory]] and [[decision problem|decision procedures]] associated with knowledge representation. This research has been important in the development of the [[Web Ontology Language]] (OWL)<ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Grau | first1 = B. C.  | last2 = Horrocks | first2 = I. | author-link2 = Ian Horrocks| last3 = Motik | first3 = B. | last4 = Parsia | first4 = B. | last5 = Patel-Schneider | first5 = P. Sattler's research has been funded by the [[Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council]] (EPSRC).<ref>{{cite web|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140808152447/http://gtr.rcuk.ac.uk/person/398D67FA-6AC1-4C94-8AE1-DACCDE3F8601|url=http://gtr.rcuk.ac.uk/person/398D67FA-6AC1-4C94-8AE1-DACCDE3F8601|title=UK Government grants awarded to Ulrike Sattler|publisher=[[Research Councils UK]]|archive-date=2014-08-08}}</ref> She is the co-author of the textbook ''An Introduction to Description Logic'' with [[Ian Horrocks]], [[Franz Baader]] and Carsten Lutz.<ref name=dlbook>{{cite book|last1=Baader|first1=Franz|last2=Horrocks|first2=Ian|last3=Lutz|first3=Carsten|last4=Sattler|first4=Uli|year=2017|doi=10.1017/9781139025355|title=An Introduction to Description Logic|publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]]|location=Cambridge|isbn=9781139025355|oclc=990330256}}</ref>

=== Academic service ===
Sattler serves as Editor-in-Chief of the ''[[Transactions on Graph Data and Knowledge]]'', as editor of the ''[[Journal of Logic and Computation]]'', and on the [[editorial board]] of the ''[[Journal of Automated Reasoning]]''. Moreover, she has been the [[Chairman|chair]] for various conferences including the [[International Joint Conference on Automated Reasoning]] (IJCAR).<ref name="ijcar">{{cite web |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131004055043/http://www.ijcar.org/SteeringCommittee.html|url=http://www.ijcar.org/SteeringCommittee.html|archive-date=2013-10-04|title=IJCAR Steering Committee}}</ref>

=== Awards and honours===
Sattler was elected a member of the [[Academia Europaea]] (MAE) in 2014.<ref name=mae>{{cite web|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140417014837/http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Sattler_Ulrike|url=http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Sattler_Ulrike|archive-date=2014-04-17|title=Ulrike Sattler at the Academy of Europe|publisher=ae-info.org}}</ref> She was co-recipient with {{ill|Bijan Parsia|qid=Q30234563}} and Matthew Horridge of the best paper prize at the [[International Semantic Web Conference]] (ISWC) in 2008<ref name=iswc2008>{{Cite book | last1 = Horridge | first1 = M. | last2 = Parsia | first2 = B. | last3 = Sattler | first3 = U. | author-link3 = Ulrike Sattler| doi = 10.1007/978-3-540-88564-1_21 | chapter = Laconic and Precise Justifications in OWL | title = The Semantic Web - ISWC 2008 | series = Lecture Notes in Computer Science | volume = 5318 | pages = 323–338 | year = 2008 | isbn = 978-3-540-88563-4 }}</ref><ref name="iswc">{{cite web|url=http://iswc2008.semanticweb.org/|title=The 7th International Semantic Web Conference (ISWC 2008)|website=Iswc2008.semanticweb.org|access-date=26 November 2018}}</ref> which subsequently won the {{ill|SWSA Ten Year award|qid= Q42307078}} in 2018 for the highest impact paper from the ISWC proceedings ten years prior.<ref name=swsa>{{cite web|url=http://swsa.semanticweb.org/content/swsa-ten-year-award|title=SWSA Ten-Year Award|website=Swsa.semanticweb.org|access-date=26 November 2018}}</ref>
